book.name: 2 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha ya kabhiri ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Ambe, abhaatu abhaandi bharabhuga, enye Pauro ni munyoohu hano nikubha hamwe neemwe, nawe omuhaari hano nikubha kure. Kweego, ndabhiisasaama kwo obhusuuku no obhunyoohu bhwa Krisito.

Nirabhiisasaama kubha, mutaanikora nibhe muhaari hano nikuuza kweemwe eyo. Niragaamba ego, kwo obhugazuro, nimenyiri niranagya kubha muhaari kubhaatu bhoosi bhano bhakwiiseega kubha, etwe turiikara kya abhaatu abhaandi bha mukyaaro kino.
Yiingabha turiikara mukyaaro kino, tutakurwaana eriihi kya abhaatu bha mukyaaro kino.
Ebhigwaato bhye eriihi ryeetu bhitari bhino abhaatu bhakurwaanira mukyaaro kino, nawe ni bhino bhine eziinguru zya Taatabhugya, na bhiragwiisya eriigoobhe ryoosi ryo omubhisa.
Turasarya amiiseego goosi go orurimi na amangʼana goosi go okwiikumya gano gakuribhira abhaatu okumumenya Taatabhugya. Kweeki turagwaata amiiseego goosi, okubha gamwiigwe Krisito.
Na hano mukubha abhiigwa mugoosi, etwe turabha twiibhanwiiri okutina ekiina kumangʼana goosi gano gatari go obhwiigwa.
Mugaroreerere amangʼana gano gari embere wa ameeso geenyu! Omuutu wowoosi wuno akwiirora kubha ewe ni wa Krisito, ahiite kubha neetwe twoosi ni bha Krisito, kyeego ewe.
Hamwe niriikumya bhukongʼu iguru yo obhunagya bhuno Omukuru atuheeri. Nawe nitakurora soni, kwo okubha obhunagya bhuyo bhutakubhasarya, nawe bhurabhagumirya mubhwiikirirya.
Nitakweenda nirorekane kweemwe kubha, ndeenda kubhakaanga muziinyaarubha zyaane.

Niragaamba ego, kwo okubha bharabhuga, “Eziinyaarubha zya Pauro zina amangʼana makongʼu, kweeki amangʼana mahaari. Nawe hano akubha hamwe neetwe atakubha na amanaga, kweeki amangʼana gaaye garabha gatana bhweera.”
Omuutu wuno akubhuga ego, amenye kubha, gano tukubhakaamira hano turi kure, nigo gano turaakore hano tukubha hamwe neemwe.
Etwe tutakusakya okwiibhara hamwe na abhaatu bhano bhakwiikumya! Nawe bhatamenyiri ryoryoosi kwo okubha bhariiriingʼaania abheene kwa abheene no okwiituubhya abheene kwa abheene.
Nawe etwe tutakwiikumya kuhita ekireengo kye emirimo gino tuheerwe. Turiikumya ego iguru we emirimo gino Taatabhugya atuheeri. Emirimo giyo nigyo gino tukukora naabhe kweemwe.
Tutakwiikumya kuhita ekireengo kye emirimo gyeetu, eraabhe tuungabheeri turakora tukyaari okuhika kweemwe. Nawe etwe twaari bho okutaanga okubhareetera Amangʼana Amazomu iguru wa Krisito.

Kweeki tutakwiikumya iguru we emirimo gya abhaatu abhaandi, emirimo gino etwe tutaheerwe. Nawe turiisigira kubha, eraabhe obhwiikirirya bhweenyu bhurageenderera okukura, niigo emirimo gyeetu gatigati weenyu gikubha giriiyoongerya.
Hayo niho tukunagya okuraarika Amangʼana Amazomu mubhyaaro ebhiindi bhino amangʼana gayo gakyaari kuraarikwa. Nikyo tutakwiikumya iguru we emirimo gino omuutu owuundi yaagikoriri hagiro ahaandi.
Amakaamo Amahoreeru garabhuga, “Omuutu wuyo woosi wuno akwiikumya, yiikumye kwiiguru wo Omukuru.”
Obhugazuro bhwaku ni kubha, omuutu wuyo woosi wuno akwiikumya omweene atakwiikiriribhwa, nawe wuno Omukuru akumuzomera, niwe akwiikiriribhwa.
